description: Curated labeled queries covering core AURA platform research memories. Labels are relevance judgments, not factual truth labels.

memories.research_question: How does retrieval augmented generation reranking work?
memories.content: A reranker scores candidate passages after initial retrieval to improve relevance ordering.

memories.research_question: How do worker leases and fencing tokens prevent stale updates?
memories.content: Lease ownership tokens fence stale workers and prevent expired owners from overwriting replacement state.

memories.research_question: How are experiment parameter snapshots used for reproducibility?
memories.content: Immutable parameter snapshots and environment manifests preserve experiment inputs and runtime provenance.

memories.research_question: How does scholarly source provenance and DOI deduplication work?
memories.content: DOI and arXiv identifiers create canonical source identities and duplicate records retain richer metadata.

memories.research_question: How does bearer authentication and role authorization protect the API?
memories.content: Bearer API keys map identities to reader operator and admin roles with endpoint authorization.

memories.research_question: How does managed MongoDB deployment keep durable data off a laptop?
memories.content: API and worker containers share a managed MongoDB URI while local MongoDB is an opt-in profile.

memories.research_question: How are process metrics and structured logs correlated?
memories.content: Request trace run job and task identifiers correlate structured logs and Prometheus metrics.

memories.research_question: How does research memory retrieval rank previous findings?
memories.content: A deterministic retriever combines query term overlap in tags content and research questions.
